title: Ordinary etale base change of the standard zero-section pasting map
statement:
Fix a finite purity setting $P$, with coefficient ring $\Lambda$ and field $k$ [def-pur-conventions]. Let $B,B'$ be affine schemes of finite type over $k$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], with structure map $a_B$ on $B$, and let $b:B'	o B$ be etale and finite type [def-weil-etale-morphism]. For $r\geq0$, let $p_r:\mathbf A^r_B	o B$ and $z_r:B	o\mathbf A^r_B$ be the standard projection and zero section [def-sbc-affine-space], and put $D_r=Lz_r^*\omega_{p_r}$ on the ordinary etale site. Write $
u_{d,e}:D_d\otimes^L D_e\overset\sim\longrightarrow D_{d+e}$ for the ordered-block map constructed in [lem-pur-diagonal-section-pasting]. Let $D'_r$ and $
u'_{d,e}$ denote the corresponding objects and maps over $B'$. Let $c_r:Lb^*D_r\overset\sim\longrightarrow D'_r$ be exactly the sectionBaseChange isomorphism of [lem-pur-dnc-section-geometry], for the Cartesian affine-space square and its zero sections. For all $d,e\geq0$, using the canonical derived inverse-image tensor constraint $	au_b$ [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], the equality $c_{d+e}\circ Lb^*(
u_{d,e})=
u'_{d,e}\circ(c_d\otimes^L c_e)\circ	au_b$ holds. This is an ordinary-etale equality, with no comparison between sites. It includes empty schemes and zero ranks.

proof.text: Use the Cartesian affine-space squares for ranks d, e and d+e. Both block projections and all zero sections commute with the affine-space base-change maps, by their coordinate formulas. The two adjacent tower squares are Cartesian, since adjoining the two independent coordinate blocks is a polynomial base change. Thus the entire ordered affine tower is the base change of the original one, also with empty blocks.

Apply SigmaBaseChange from [lem-pur-dualizing-sigma-cocycle-locality] to the two adjacent squares and pull its equality back along the new total zero section. The definition of nu in [lem-pur-diagonal-section-pasting] first identifies the d factor by the inverse smooth base-change mate and the e factor by the inverse-image compositor, then applies inverse monoidal pullback and the pulled-back sigma. Naturality and composition of the derived tensor constraint move the pulled-back tensor constraint in the sigma equation before these two comparisons.

Expand sectionBaseChange from [lem-pur-dnc-section-geometry]. Use [lem-weil-pbc-mate-pasting] to paste Cartesian exceptional base-change mates; this identifies the first factor comparison obtained in the previous step with bc_d, and inverse-image composition coherence identifies the second with bc_e. The target comparison is bc_(d+e), since the pasted tower projection is p_(d+e). Substitute these three identifications and cancel the inverse compositors. This gives the stated equality. The mate and compositor identities are independent of nonemptiness or positive rank.

lean.statement:
theorem standardSectionPasting_baseChange (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    {B' B : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine B'] [IsAffine B]
    (d e : ℕ) (b : B' ⟶ B) [Etale b]
    (aB : B ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType aB] [QuasiCompact aB]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType b] [QuasiCompact b] :
    letI := P.noetherian aB
    letI := P.noetherian (b ≫ aB)
    letI := P.comparedExponent (𝟙 (Spec (.of P.field.k)))
    let bc := fun r : ℕ ↦
      letI := Dnc.invertibleExponent P (DiagonalPasting.pr r B ≫ aB)
      letI := Dnc.compactifiable P (DiagonalPasting.pr r B) aB
      letI := Dnc.compactifiable P (DiagonalPasting.pr r B') (b ≫ aB)
      letI := DiagonalPasting.affineDimension r B
      Dnc.sectionBaseChange P.Coefficient r (DiagonalPasting.pr r B)
        (AffineSpace.isPullback_map b) (DiagonalPasting.zero r B)
        (DiagonalPasting.zero r B') (AffineSpace.zeroSection_comp_map b)
    (Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) b).leftDerivedFunctor.mapIso
        (DiagonalPasting.nu P.Coefficient P d e B aB) ≪≫ bc (d + e) =
      Etale.leftDerivedUpperStarTensorIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) b
        (DiagonalPasting.zeroInvariant P.Coefficient P d B)
        (DiagonalPasting.zeroInvariant P.Coefficient P e B) ≪≫
      DiagonalPasting.tensorComparison P.Coefficient P (bc d) (bc e) ≪≫
        DiagonalPasting.nu P.Coefficient P d e B' (b ≫ aB)
